g.text: B denotes batch size. The two MaxViT encoders have independent weights. Labels: 0 = non-glaucoma, 1 = glaucoma.

g.text: Dashed arrows: post-hoc test calibration; T is fitted on validation logits. Training uses class-weighted cross-entropy on raw logits.
